title: Paeoniflorin alleviates nephrolithiasis by targeting serpine1 and inhibiting the NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Sun, Yan; Zhang, Xiaoyu; Chen, Xiaoyu; Zhao, Jiawen; Liu, Yunlong; He, Weiyang
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨芍药苷通过Serpine1/NF-kappaB通路缓解肾结石，核心是药物-蛋白互作与炎症机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Paeoniflorin (PF) is a bioactive monoterpene glycoside with well-established anti-inflammatory properties; however, its therapeutic potential and molecular mechanism in nephrolithiasis remain insufficiently defined. In this study, network pharmacology was employed to predict potential targets of PF. In vitro, HK-2 cells exposed to calcium oxalate (CaOx) crystals were treated with PF to evaluate inflammatory responses, crystal adhesion, and NF-kappaB activation. A glyoxylic acid-induced mouse model was used to assess renal crystal deposition, renal function, and expression of key regulatory targets, supported by transcriptomic profiling. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to analyze the interaction between PF and Serpine1, and functional relevance was further examined using exogenous Serpine1 rescue experiments. Integrated analyses indicated that PF exerts anti-nephrolithic effects predominantly through modulation of inflammation-associated signaling. PF dose-dependently suppressed CaOx-induced NF-kappaB phosphorylation and nuclear translocation, reduced the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta), and decreased crystal adhesion in HK-2 cells. In vivo, PF markedly attenuated renal crystal deposition, improved renal functional indices, and downregulated renal Serpine1 and IL-1beta expression. Computational simulations supported a stable interaction between PF and Serpine1 (binding energy - 6.22 kcal/mol). Consistently, supplementation with exogenous Serpine1 partially reversed PF-mediated inhibition of NF-kappaB activation and cytoprotective effects. Collectively, these findings suggest that PF mitigates CaOx-associated renal injury by suppressing inflammation-centered signaling programs involving the Serpine1/NF-kappaB axis, thereby providing mechanistic insight into PF as a potential multi-target therapeutic candidate for nephrolithiasis.
abstract_zh: 芍药苷（Paeoniflorin, PF）是一种具有公认抗炎特性的生物活性单萜糖苷；然而，其在肾结石病中的治疗潜力及分子机制尚未充分阐明。本研究采用网络药理学预测PF的潜在靶点。体外实验中，暴露于草酸钙（calcium oxalate, CaOx）晶体的HK-2细胞经PF处理后，评估炎症反应、晶体粘附及NF-kappaB活化。利用乙醛酸诱导的小鼠模型评估肾晶体沉积、肾功能及关键调控靶点的表达，并辅以转录组学分析。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析PF与Serpine1之间的相互作用，并利用外源性Serpine1拯救实验进一步验证其功能相关性。综合分析表明，PF主要通过调节炎症相关信号发挥抗肾结石作用。PF剂量依赖性地抑制CaOx诱导的NF-kappaB磷酸化及核转位，减少促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6和IL-1beta）的释放，并降低HK-2细胞中的晶体粘附。体内实验中，PF显著减轻肾晶体沉积，改善肾功能指标，并下调肾组织中Serpine1和IL-1beta的表达。计算模拟支持PF与Serpine1之间的稳定相互作用（结合能为-6.22 kcal/mol）。一致地，外源性Serpine1的补充部分逆转了PF介导的NF-kappaB活化抑制及细胞保护效应。综上，这些发现表明PF通过抑制涉及Serpine1/NF-kappaB轴的炎症中心信号通路，减轻CaOx相关肾损伤，从而为PF作为肾结石病的潜在多靶点治疗候选药物提供机制性见解。
